research_question: Does the fixed-tail mapped mass provide additional physically admissible tail or conditional-resource benefit beyond its entrywise triangle envelope?

objectives.PR: f/f_star + gamma*(M_epsilon/M_star)^2; current coefficients T and original tail
objectives.ENTRY: f/f_star + beta*(B_eta/B_star)^2; B=sum ordered w_ij*hypot(J_ij,eta), tail only; w_ii=5/4,w_ij=3/2
objectives.entry_epsilon_policy: eta=epsilon*(2*n+1)/(1.5*n-0.25); same zero floor, not identical smoothing
objectives.exact_diagnostic: B_0-lambda=sum_tail_rows(sum_j abs(J_ij)-abs(sum_j J_ij)); exact zero-epsilon limit
objectives.historical_RC2: context only; no new full-L2 arm planned

conditions.U: frame-wise real orthogonal; existing corrected codec

input_policy: Byte identities reusable; no array decoding in this preparation. Original qualified common start recommended; no PR-only warm start as neutral evidence. B_star evaluated once only inside a future approved setup call.
candidate_identity_policy: Per-arm objective version, input/scales, initialization, SOURCE and endpoint J/U hashes; never relabel old endpoint as new comparator. No new endpoint exists.

comparison_I.meaning: objective capability at common physical budget and comparable engineering stationarity
comparison_I.strength_policy: finite prespecified symmetric relative-strength selection; all outcomes retained; common physical budget admission, compare exact lambda over common feasible accuracy range; no selection using held-out native prices
comparison_I.optimizer: reuse latest recentered reduced search after both arms have same-array coefficient/gradient/Hessian and stability adaptation
comparison_I.stationarity: proposed common J-infinity and physical U-tangent engineering thresholds 1e-5 with existing margins; numerical admission separate from raw solver success

comparison_II.meaning: practical fixed-budget recipe comparison, not objective superiority
comparison_II.policy: same initial penalty contribution is one reproducible pilot policy only; same start and counts of solves/evaluations with recorded CPU/wall; beta/gamma not treated as comparable final error
comparison_II.unconverged_endpoint: descriptive finite-recipe outcome; no objective-capability claim

stages.scope: paired optimization and independent physical error/tail diagnostics
stages.progression: both arms correctness and DF admission; if one unqualified report without winner for comparison I; no automatic restart

stages.scope: candidate-specific physical/ground/alias -> PF/RTE -> attenuation -> RPE W/shots -> native -> shell total -> same-J/U strong D
stages.progression: requires separately fixed downstream contract and permission; no automatic continuation

downstream.common_r_comparison: recommend same r32 for DF-only conditional comparison; PR-derived choice disclosed; not best-r certification
downstream.candidate_retuning: optional common finite r policy for both objectives, fixed before results; existing 16/32/64/128 policy is a possible reuse, not adopted here
downstream.statistics: new holdout seeds, no pooling design/exploration cohorts; fix estimand/precision/interval/multiplicity before calibration
downstream.qualification: conditional ideal accounting remains separate from all-law error, ideal-law price, actual CA and validated coverage

logical_calls.optimization_template: C_shared + sum_over_arms_and_registered_strengths_starts(C_setup_arm + 6*P + 2*A + 1) + C_comparison, only if unchanged stable-oracle instrumentation is validated; P<=1+accepted_update_limit*trial_limit. Six=3 inner+2 precision+1 admission; 2 per accepted update=independent terminal+physical; +1 initial physical. Not a closed bound for new runner.
logical_calls.native_template: 9*N per registered candidate/r cell + candidate-specific preparation/reference/shell + calibration/final summaries; old published N256 maximum2374 is not transferred
logical_calls.reason_unfixed: strength/start grid, common stopping budget, stable ENTRY oracle adaptation and downstream calibration not yet fixed

correctness_FAIL: retain partial evidence and STOP; never relax thresholds or replace an arm

resources.acceleration: reuse cached ffsim/JAX, fixed-U linear map/Hessian, same-array extended arithmetic; parallel independent arms/strengths only in separate processes after actual resource check
resources.noninterference: task-local cache/output; shared environments and other jobs unchanged

unresolved_before_execution: choose comparison I or II and finite strength/initialization/optimization budget policy
adapt and synthetically verify ENTRY same-array extended coefficient and reduced-oracle path; PR-only checks must not silently dispatch ENTRY as RC2
freeze endpoint selection and scientific effect/precision thresholds without native holdout leakage
close exact call counts and full SOURCE/runtime/input manifest for the future runner
if saved XDF added, reconcile Codex-A audit; not a prerequisite for this two-objective design
obtain separate explicit scientific execution permission after concrete fixed scope
